newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear division sells business for $43 mln.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear division sells business for $43 mln.

text.p: Goodyear Tire and Rubber Co's Engineered Products Division said Monday it sold its engineered composite business to Cambridge Industries for $43 million.
The company said the engineered composite business, located 75 miles southeast of Columbus, is a supplier of reinforced plastics products for the automotive industry.
Cambridge is based in Madison Heights, Mich.
Goodyear's Engineered Products Division said it will continue to restructure its businesses to concentrate where it can excel globally.
Goodyear's Engineered Products Division includes businesses in conveyor and power transmission belts, air springs, hose, molded rubber products and transportation replacement products.
